projects.title: The Glass Pavilion
projects.subtitle: A study in transparency and restraint.
projects.seo_description: A study in transparency and restraint located in Mumbai.

sections.title: The Brief
sections.body: Our clients envisioned a retreat that blurred the boundaries between the lush tropical exterior and the interior living spaces. The challenge was to maintain privacy while maximizing transparency, resulting in a material palette rooted in honesty—exposed concrete, natural travertine, and untreated timber.

sections.title: 01 Living
sections.body: The living space acts as a central volume, anchored by a monolithic concrete fireplace. Furniture was kept intentionally low-slung to avoid obstructing the garden vistas.
